entries.summary: The approximately 93-day signal weakens from Δχ² 28.29 to about 6.43 with broader red-noise coverage. Early and late coefficients also differ (conditional p 0.000885); one observing-day deletion lowers Δχ² to 20.92. TPA has 79.4% conditional detection power but does not corroborate the waveform (fixed-period Δχ² 2.318; coefficient-contrast p 0.000526). Extrapolation and noise uncertainty limit exclusion.
entries.scope: Four bounded steps; 512 nulls and 256 injections; existing TPA fixed-period comparison. Original search preserved.
